aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable evidence but changed-factor and comparison grouping are inconsistent.
issues: Changed factor names only WE-4638HS while outcomes include three test bonds.
Test bond names and bond amounts are mixed as subgroup keys instead of condition levels.
WE-4637H vision comparison likely uses wrong normal row; date grouping is not preserved.
Tension outcome is not judged despite clear spec failures versus normal rows.
Some cited rows needed for grouping are not shown in context.
correctionPlan: Define primary factor as normal PT-8310M9S versus each new bond type.
Keep date, line, type, bond amount, and test bond as row-level grouping keys.
Pair each test condition with the matching normal row by date/test context.
Clean tension conditions for all cited rows and judge against >0.3 kgf spec.
Separate vision NG-rate and tension outcomes under the same bond-change context.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but grouping citations are insufficient until hidden cited rows are reviewed.
